newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire Q1 results helped by GEICO.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire Q1 results helped by GEICO.

text.p: Berkshire Hathaway Inc said Wednesday its first quarter 1997 earnings were helped by GEICO underwriting results, which "continued to be outstanding."
Over the last 12 months, Berkshire said GEICO saw voluntary auto policy growth of 12.7 percent, led by major gains in standard and non-standard auto lines.
Berkshire said pre-tax operating results reflect dividend income of about $55 million related to Berkshire's investment in US Airways cumulative convertible preferred stock.
As of March 31, Berkshire said US Airways was current with respect to its dividend obligations.
First quarter 1997 includes results of FlightSafety, which Berkshire bought at the end of 1996.
Berkshire reported first quarter earnings from operations of $263.1 million vs. $160.2 million in the first quarter of 1996.
